snippet.title: Deep Fog Signals Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
TRANSMISSION INCOMING:
The Steam page for Deep Fog Signals is now live 📡

Stuck in an outpost deep in a sea of toxic fog, your crew has been decimated, you're cut off from the outside world, and oxygen is running out. Use limited bandwidth to coordinate unstable crewmates, conduct esoteric research that could change the world, and interpret strange signals from the deep. 

Deep Fog Signals is a short atmospheric 2D horror puzzle adventure. A standalone prequel to Misgiven, it offers a unique, darker take on the same rich sci-fi universe. 

What you can expect:
🌫️ An atmosphere denser than the deadly fog closing in on you
🧩 Solving puzzles on intriguing sci-fi devices
🖌️ A mix of hand-drawn 2D art and retro-futuristic digital interfaces
💔 Characters you may love, hate or love to hate
🪨 Hard choices and multiple endings

Deep Fog Signals is planned to release early 2026!
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4100900/Deep_Fog_Signals/

Track by Elektrobear: https://moonanagames.itch.io/80-songs-pack
